description: Browse products startups have built and the stack each runs on: what it is, whether it is a website, a mobile app, both or a desktop app, its category and pricing, and every framework and service it uses (services link to the directory and, where priced, the cost engine). Use it to find real stacks to learn from, e.g. apps built with Supabase. Results list each filter value with counts. Example: {"tech":"supabase","form":"app"}.

form.description: How it ships. web: a website (maybe with a desktop app). app: a mobile app only. both: a website and a mobile app. desktop: a desktop app with no website (maybe with a mobile app).

platform.description: Runs on this platform, whatever else it runs on.

query.description: Words to match against names, taglines, makers and the stack, e.g. "habit tracker", "Expo".

tech.description: A tech key from facets.tech: a directory id such as "supabase", or a framework such as "next-js".

name: search_showcase

assumptions.description: Usage and pricing assumptions behind the numbers.

caveats.description: Show to the user word for word.

data.description: The tool result. Its shape depends on the tool.

disclosures.description: Always includes the neutrality note: no vendor pays for a place in the answer. Link its url when you mention how Kong Reviews is paid.

title: Search the startup showcase
